name: agentflow
description: Spec-driven, test-first workflow driven from the chat: /agentflow:feature (spec dialogue, background run with a live view, gates in plain words, cleanup), /agentflow:resume, /agentflow:status, plus phase-lock (PreToolUse) and require-green (Stop) hooks that call the agentflow CLI.
